title: 13th Sitting of second session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/13/2/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the names of candidates who responded to the Majlis Secretariat's announcement for the member of the public to be appointed by Parliament to the Judicial Service Commission, under Article 158(f) of the Constitution and Article 3(6) of Law No. 10/2008 (Judicial Service Commission Act), are sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the government-sponsored Public Referendum Bill (on holding public votes to seek the people's opinion), submitted by Inguraidhoo MP Ibrahim Falah.

Continued debate on the State-Owned Enterprises Committee's report on the state of Maldives Marketing and Public Relations Corporation Ltd (MMPRC) and Maldives Integrated Tourism Development Corporation Ltd (MITDC).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to send Judicial Service Commission public-seat candidates to committee, begin debating the Public Referendum Bill, and continue debating the committee report on MMPRC and MITDC.
